plain_description: Generate high-quality code across 600+ programming languages with a model trained on 4+ trillion tokens. It handles code completion, infilling, and generation tasks out of the box. The bottom line: get production-ready code suggestions without building your own model.
technical_description: StarCoder2-15B is a 15-billion-parameter causal language model trained on The Stack v2 dataset using the Fill-in-the-Middle objective. It implements a transformer decoder architecture with grouped-query attention and a 16,384-token context window with 4,096-token sliding window attention. The model is distributed via Hugging Face Transformers, supports CPU and GPU inference, and offers quantized inference through bitsandbytes (8-bit and 4-bit). It was trained with the NVIDIA NeMo Framework on 1024 H100 GPUs.
title: StarCoder2
